answer.policy_title: Musculoskeletal Appropriate Use Criteria: Spine Surgery
criteria_quotes: This guideline addresses lumbar discectomy, foraminotomy, and laminotomy when performed as elective, non-emergent procedures and not as part of the care of an acute or traumatic event.

Prior to any intervention, it is essential that the clinician confirm the diagnosis or establish its pretest likelihood based on a complete evaluation of the patient. This includes a history and physical examination and, where applicable, a review of relevant laboratory studies, diagnostic testing, and response to prior therapeutic intervention.
The anticipated benefit of the recommended intervention is likely to outweigh any potential harms, including from delay or decreased access to services that may result (net benefit).

Widely used treatment guidelines and/or current clinical literature and/or standards of medical practice should support that the recommended intervention offers the greatest net benefit among competing alternatives.
There exists a reasonable likelihood that the intervention will change management and/or lead to an improved outcome for the patient.

Providers may be required to submit clinical documentation in support of a request for services. Such documentation must a) accurately reflect the clinical situation at the time of the requested service, and b) sufficiently document the ordering provider’s clinical intent.
answer.appeal_deadline: The appeal must be received by 2027-02-20, which is 180 days after the 2026-08-24 notice date, as stated in the denial letter.
answer.submission_route: Submit a commercial/member appeal using PacificSource's member appeal process. The current PacificSource information retrieved states that an appeal may be submitted by mail to PacificSource Health Plans, Attn: Grievance Review, PO Box 7068, Springfield, OR 97475-0068; by email to newappeal@pacificsource.com; or by fax to 541-322-6424. Identify the request as a preauthorization appeal and include member Skyler Ellison, member ID W240749705, reference POC-1C51E72E1E-65750, CPT 63030, the denial notice, and supporting clinical records. The provider may also assist with submission.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: PacificSource's provider medical-prior-authorization page states: 'Criteria for prior authorization decisions' may be requested from its Health Services team and can be emailed, faxed, or mailed. Contact PacificSource Health Services at CS@PacificSource.com or 888-691-8209 (TTY 711). PacificSource lists the Idaho Health Services fax as 208-333-1597 and the mailing address as PacificSource Health Plans, Attn: Health Services, PO Box 7068, Springfield, OR 97475-0068. Request the exact Carelon Spine Surgery criteria/version used for reference POC-1C51E72E1E-65750 and ask for the complete clinical-review rationale and missing-documentation list.
answer.notes: PacificSource's publicly available 'Spinal Surgery' policy is at https://pacificsource.com/sites/default/files/2025-02/Spinal%20Surgery.pdf and its search result states that PacificSource considers spine surgery medically necessary when the criteria in the Carelon Musculoskeletal Spine Surgery Guideline are met. The Carelon document above is therefore the publicly available governing medical-necessity guideline identified for this request. The PacificSource PDF itself could not be text-extracted by the retrieval system, so its policy number and revision date were not independently confirmed from the PDF. The Carelon guideline states that approval and implementation dates may vary by health plan; PacificSource should confirm that this was the version applied on the 2026-08-24 review date. The retrieved public materials provide the general clinical-appropriateness requirements quoted above, but not a complete procedure-specific checklist for CPT 63030. Request that checklist and the case-specific rationale directly from PacificSource.

Date of notice: 2026-08-24
Member: Skyler Ellison
Member ID: W240749705
Plan: PacificSource Health Plans (Commercial/ACA), state of Idaho

Dear Skyler,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your provider for the following service:

    Requested service: Lower back disc surgery / decompression
    Procedure code (CPT): 63030

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the documentation submitted was incomplete and does not allow a determination of medical necessity.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-02-20).

Reference number: POC-1C51E72E1E-65750

Register for InTouch for Members How to get care After hours or emergency care If you have a true medical emergency, always go directly to the nearest emergency room, or call 911 for help. If you're facing a non-life-threatening emergency, contact your doctor's office, or go to an urgent care facility. In-network urgent care centers are listed in our online provider directory . Simply enter your city and state or zip code, then select \"Urgent Care\" in the \"Specialty Category\" field. Don't have a doctor yet? Let us help you find one. See our Find a Doctor page . Not sure if you should go to ER or urgent care? See our Urgent and Emergency Care guide . Your member ID Always show your PacificSource member ID at your doctor's office or pharmacy. If your plan starts at a future date (for example, the first of next month), you'll need to wait until that date to print a member ID. For current members: Please call Customer Service or visit InTouch for Members to request a new ID. From InTouch, you can also print an ID to use until your replacement card arrives. Note: Your member ID will only show your eligibility in effect on the day you print your ID. If you are a renewing member and have upcoming changes to your plan, your new eligibility will show on your ID only after your plan's renewal date. This information is available to you 24/7 online through our secure member portal, InTouch for Members . You'll need to register when you use InTouch for the first time. All you need is a valid email address, your member ID number (on your member ID card ), or your Social Security number. Flu shots Flu shots are typically covered by your PacificSource plan. Learn more on our Flu Prevention page . Exclusions Your plan may exclude some procedures, services, and medications. You'll find information specific to your plan in your member handbook or policy. Your member handbook or benefits summary is available through InTouch. You're welcome to contact Customer Service if you have questions or need assistance. Costs you may have to pay To learn more about what costs you may have to pay as part of your plan, such as copayments and deductibles, see your member handbook or benefit summary. These documents are available through InTouch for Members . You're also welcome to contact Customer Service for assistance. Reading your explanation of benefits (EOB) Your EOB is a summary of recent services you've had, such as a doctor visit or lab work. It tells you how much the doctor billed, how much your plan paid, and the balance, if any, you owe to your provider. You'll also find deductible balance and other information. If you have questions about how to read your EOB, check out our Your explanation of benefits (EOB) page. Your EOB statement will be sent to you after we have processed a claim. Customer Service can also help you find doctors, dentists, and hospitals in your area and provide details about their services and professional qualifications.
